title: Coleção de Febre Amarela (CFA)
citation: Instituto Oswaldo Cruz / Museu da Patologia, Coleção de Febre Amarela (CFA), current online collection record (2026).
tags: Brazil; yellow fever; Rockefeller Foundation; histopathology; glass slides; paraffin blocks; diagnosis; conservation
note: A case-linked pathology collection generated by the yellow-fever campaign. The museum describes about 498,000 cases, each structured around preserved liver material, a paraffin block and stained histological section(s) on glass, with associated diagnostic documentation. The collection history records deterioration/loss of some blocks and slides, while the project portfolio documents cleaning, slide boxes, labels, barcodes, digitization and research consultation.

title: Curioscopio
citation: INIMEC-CONICET-UNC, Curioscopio, current service and teaching-preparation record (2026).
tags: Argentina; Córdoba; permanent preparations; teaching kit; school microscopy; atlas; staining; mounting
note: A contemporary material teaching system built around permanent preparations of plant, animal, microbial and cultured-cell material for school microscopes. The kit joins physical preparations to an educational atlas and activity guides; the institutional description explicitly sets out fixation, solid embedding, thin sectioning, staining and final permanent mounting. It therefore functions as a preparation-plus-text teaching publication rather than a generic microscopy resource.

authors: José Geraldo Antunes de Paiva; Suzane Margaret Fank-de-Carvalho; Maurício Pimenta Magalhães; Dalva Graciano-Ribeiro
title: Verniz vitral incolor 500®: uma alternativa de meio de montagem economicamente viável
citation: José Geraldo Antunes de Paiva, Suzane Margaret Fank-de-Carvalho, Maurício Pimenta Magalhães, and Dalva Graciano-Ribeiro, “Verniz vitral incolor 500®: uma alternativa de meio de montagem economicamente viável,” Acta Botanica Brasilica 20, no. 2 (2006): 257–264.
tags: Brazil; mounting medium; permanent slides; plant anatomy; Canada balsam; Euparal; Entellan; Permount; conservation

citation: Juliana Quadros and Emygdio L. de A. Monteiro-Filho, “Coleta e preparação de pêlos de mamíferos para identificação em microscopia óptica,” Revista Brasileira de Zoologia 23, no. 1 (2006): 274–278.
tags: Brazil; mammal hair; reference collection; glass slides; cuticular impressions; Entellan; glycerin; preparation method
note: An experimental preparation paper that compares methods for a mammal-hair reference collection. Cuticular impressions are made on glass slides using clear nail varnish; permanent preparations are mounted with Entellan and temporary ones with glycerin. Physical slide construction is part of the tested method rather than an incidental observation stage.

authors: Josefina Bodnar; Eduardo Manuel Morel; Eliana Paula Coturel; Patricio Alan Knight; Maricel Centi Ferrei
title: History of the paleobotanical collections of the Museo de La Plata during the 19th and 20th centuries
citation: Josefina Bodnar, Eduardo Manuel Morel, Eliana Paula Coturel, Patricio Alan Knight, and Maricel Centi Ferrei, “History of the paleobotanical collections of the Museo de La Plata during the 19th and 20th centuries,” Publicación Electrónica de la Asociación Paleontológica Argentina 25, no. 1 (2025): 198–210.
tags: Argentina; Museo de La Plata; paleobotany; microscopic preparations; fossil wood; cuticles; pollen; teaching; collection history
note: A collection-history study in which the microscopic-preparation collection is one of the two central paleobotanical collections. The article reports approximately 1,600 microscope-slide preparations of fossil woods, leaf cuticles and pollen/spores, traces the collection from late-nineteenth/early-twentieth-century Roth material through Frenguelli and Archangelsky, and follows its use in university teaching and postgraduate research.
